title: adidas HyperBoost Euphoria LT Trainers (Silver/White) $140 Delivered ($105 + Delivery via App with Code) @ ASOS
body:
Deal: adidas HyperBoost Euphoria LT Trainers (Silver/White) $140 Delivered ($105 + Delivery via App with Code) @ ASOS

[Feeblely] hyperboost pro foam? Im so confused with the naming. If it is the pro version, this is an amazing deal
[kalumbaface] Afaik, the Euphoria doesn't. Only the Edge and Run have hyperboost pro foam, but they also cost $340 so you can't really complain at this price because these are still exceptional.
[Spector1] This version is apparently softer than the pro
[Ez4menotu] Thanks mate, just got a few. Have a feeling they will oos very quick
[Fredfloresjr] 2.5hrs later and most sizes are in there
[hippo2s] This is the casual wear equivalent of the new Hyperboost range. Don't get this for running. Yes for walking.
[ThisAppleGuy] Thanks for the share.
Also a tip, I got a 5% off ASOS gift card via my health insurance. Check if you have any discounted gift card programs you have access to.
[GReeeeN] Ordered these during the last deal. They’re actually silver and reflective/ shiny, which isn’t really shown well in the product images.
[kalumbaface] Can confirm. This YT short shows off the shininess.
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6Mn35cwrIhY
However, from other videos I've seen the white/blue colour doesn't seem to have the shine, it has more of a flat look which I would've preferred.
[ultrakaos] Thank you, and it was a real struggling finding something to buy for $20 in order to get the free shipping.
[Ez4menotu] Should be able to cancel the one you bought on top through chat support.
[bargainmonger] shoes were not as comfortable on foot compared to the hyperboost edge. might need to try in store
[kalumbaface] Most probably, but that would be expected considering the price delta.
[ultrakaos] Yeah, $300+ vs $105.
I just wanted something for walking, hoping they're okay.
